items.title: Keter Betts interviewed by Monk Rowe, Sarasota, Florida, April 11, 1996
items.q: I ran into Milt Hinton and we started talking... he said, 'come on, I’ll take you to lunch.'

ctx.x: Well this had to be great preparation for your eventual career as a bassist I would think.
Well I switched to bass through Milt Hinton.
Because of Milt Hinton? © Fillius Jazz Archive -3-
